name: Orren Hollowbough
source_profile:
Elder Orren Hollowbough (LN)

Orren is among the oldest elders of the Coalition, and perhaps its most reluctant member. He believes Cadorian settlement is ultimately temporary—a passing disturbance that can be outlasted if his people retreat deeper into the forest. He joined the Coalition chiefly to obtain assurances that other tribes would not reveal Hollowbough settlements or travel routes during negotiations with the Cadorians.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 65 (source excerpt; may be partial)
